body_text: Question about exporting a custom report to PDF. Resolved same day.
Users unable to log in via SSO since Tuesday. Blocking daily reporting workflow. No update in 4 days.
Second team also reporting SSO login failures. Escalating internally, growing frustrated.
Dashboard load times much slower than usual this week.
New admin asking how to pull the quarterly allocation report — previous admin used to run this manually.
Minor formatting issue in exported CSV, low priority.

Reporting engine crashing on large portfolios, unresolved for over two weeks. Team is frustrated and has started evaluating alternative platforms, including a named competitor, due to slow issue resolution.
Follow-up requesting status update, no response yet from support.
Requesting clarification on how allocation drift is calculated in the monthly report.
